verdict.rationale: Community discussion confirms a real security incident (attackers reaching command-runner access) and reports that JumpCloud rotated API keys, advised rotating SSO certs, and handled the aftermath well. That is indirect evidence of responsive disclosure, but there is no first-party evidence of a published postmortem or a trust page. Missing for 10: a published incident postmortem, a live trust/status/security page, a documented disclosure history or policy, and first-party corroboration.
